race.description: First National Real Estate Murray Bridge Stake Pr2
race.comment: TERRIFIC DIXSON (7) was midfield throughout and finished there last time when 4th (31.33) at Angle Park. Strong form has emerged from his last run. Tough to beat if on-song. WAIKARIE KOBY (1) has been settling off the speed lately, finishing fourth (20.23) last time in a Other at Angle Park. Solid record at the distance winning eight races. Cannot be taken lightly. CONNECTOR (5) goes very well this trip starting 15 times for seven wins and five minors. In the money last time at this track (19.80) in a Grade 5, finishing a 2.5 lengths second. Looks suited here and can measure up. NOISY GEM (8) cannot be left out over a shorter trip.
